notes: Unpublished; staged locally, not uploaded. One pool, no held-out split (decision 2026-11-15): every case is in dev and is used for both tuning and evaluation; confirmation runs evaluate the whole pool. Real-cases 4.0.0 = the 61 cases of the v4 benchmark pool (pool61): the 27 cases of 2.0.0 (its test cases relabelled dev), 16 cases added for 3.0.0 and 18 cases from the 2026-11 expansion; aifirstcli-windows-cmd-shim from the 3.0.0 draft is not in the pool. Built with scripts/stage-release.ts --splits and scripts/package-dataset.ts; the hashes below are from the local build staged on 2026-11-20 (archive not uploaded). The url is the planned asset of release tag cases-v4.0.0 on Tracetoon/prbench (formerly Tingsters/prbench); it 404s until the archive, dataset-release.json, SHA256SUMS.txt, MANIFEST.md and DATASET_CARD.md are uploaded there. registry.json carries the same entry. The four vexagent-* bundles were history-rewritten before staging (owner work e-mail and a local path scrubbed), so their SHAs differ from the golden run's inputs; see DATASET_CARD.md.
